## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the smallest complete change and any related issue.
For a bug fix, include a minimal sanitized reproduction and the affected revision.

## Compatibility and safety

State any changes to language behavior, canonical identities, JSON/MCP contracts,
dependencies, resource limits or host grants. Write "none" where appropriate.

## Verification

List commands actually run, their outcomes and the revision tested. Include
relevant source tests or fixtures. State what was not run and why; do not infer
results from the existence of a test or workflow.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Added or updated regression tests and current references where needed.
- [ ] Checked the diff for generated artifacts, credentials and private data.
- [ ] Preserved applicable first-party and upstream license notices.

Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for verification expectations.
For sensitive findings, follow the
[security policy](https://github.com/doesntdev/apodexis/security/policy) instead of
publishing exploit details in this pull request.
